title: Drain stop-streak counts consecutive failures of the same task only
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/gpt-6-2/astra-rerun-report.md (GPT-6.2 Astra rerun on 075e12b), verified by a read-only reader 2026-11-17.
Evidence: src/cli/lane-run/drain.ts:157 counts streak exit codes regardless of which task failed.
Outcome: the streak resets when a different task fails; a test with [74 on t-a, 74 on t-b] does not stop the drain.
Proof: a regression test at the lowest layer fails before the fix and passes after.
